methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: proposes a new strategy to improve and optimize its energy system operation

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Techno-economic microgrid design for the OAKA sports complex (large-scale building). The paper reports descriptive electricity-consumption data and uses current energy cost as an economic comparison baseline, but constructs no EnPI/EnB measurement model: no normalisation of energy against relevant variables, no functional form, and no estimation approach is identifiable. Energy/EnB is incidental to a supply-side (PV+BESS+CHP+gensets) sizing study.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper evaluates the energy consumption of the Olympic Athletic Center of Athens (OAKA)

stage1.notes: Microgrid techno-economic design for OAKA sports complex (building). Reported energy 'baselines' are descriptive consumption/cost references, not an EnPI/EnB normalisation model.
